title: An unsubscribe click is never lost and never turns other emails back on

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (project thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
Two gaps in the member unsubscribe. (1) processUnsubscribe ignored the error from reading notification_preferences, so a database blip read as 'no row' and the upsert wrote DEFAULT_PREFERENCES, switching back on every email category the member had already turned off. (2) The RFC 8058 one-click POST (app/api/unsubscribe/route.ts) answered 200 even when the preference, consent or suppression write failed, so the mailbox treated the opt-out as done and it was lost with only a warn log. Fix: a failed read stops with the save-failed answer and writes nothing; the one-click route answers 503 on a failed write (logged as an error) and still 200 on a bad link, revealing nothing.

DONE 2026-11-18: both fixed with tests in app/unsubscribe/actions.test.ts and app/api/unsubscribe/route.test.ts.

verify.note: Passes while a failed read stops the unsubscribe and a failed one-click write answers 503.
